captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris asks why the report asks thirty thousand price questions.
The money step works out the same answers again for every order and every row.
You add up the takings once, sort once, and keep each price for one report.
Now the money step gives the same ranking as before, with a small part of the work.
Same report, same answers, and each piece of work done once.
